template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 3:2 game burst illustration, also cropped to a horizontal HUD banner. Create a new polished anime action portrait using the supplied image only as character identity reference. Subject: {subject} Composition: head and shoulders, face and eyes near the center, dynamic hair and dramatic rim light, readable at small size, restrained background detail, clean high-quality linework and painted shading. Preserve reference identity and clothing. No text, lettering, logos, borders or watermarks. This is presentation art, not a gameplay effect.
